items.description: WR-01 (03.6-REVIEW.md): in app/src/domain/diff.js buildRowDiff, make the row-level gramsFrom, gramsTo, gramsChanged, shareFrom and shareTo read only the lines still in (the predicate `lines` uses, including the !baseRow branch), so stepsWithStaleAmounts in domain/uses.js flags a step when one line of a split row is taken out; regression test in diff.test.js: a split row with one line taken out gives gramsChanged === true.

WR-02 (03.6-REVIEW.md): in app/src/ui/IngredientTable.jsx (~640-671) read baselineShare from the opening row through the existing active map and pass that row to rowAccessibleLabel, so opening the pen on a split row with a line already out announces no false "was X%, now Y%" on the sibling line; regression test in the IngredientTable or RecipePage test files.

WR-03 (03.6-REVIEW.md): in app/src/ui/IngredientTable.jsx (~718 and ~598) print a portion sub-line only when the line was in at open, otherwise the bare amount (rowDiff.lines[i].removedChanged says whether the out state is new), so a line already out never reads "N g of M g" with N > M; regression test. Depends on WR-02 only by sharing the file.

WR-04 (03.6-REVIEW.md): in app/src/domain/lineage.js findBlockedRow return the blocked portion index ({ row, index, message }); in app/src/ui/IngredientTable.jsx (~658 and ~680) key the focus ref by rowId:index and mark only that line as blocked; the blocked-save message becomes "needs an amount, or remove it" (Mark to see this exact text in the plan; plain words, short labels); regression tests for a row whose line 0 is out and line 1 is blank. Do not touch IN-01 or IN-02.
